title: mcp.callTool result (always a JSON-RPC result; relay/transport failures surface as gRPC errors instead)

oneOf.description: The tool ran. isError=true means the tool itself refused or failed; its error object is in error.

result.description: Parsed JSON of the tool's text content (null when isError)

oneOf.description: The bridge refused or could not run the call.

code.description: Bridge codes: MCP_INVALID_PARAMS, MCP_SERVER_NOT_ALLOWED, MCP_TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED, MCP_PROJECT_DIR_OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE, MCP_PROJECT_DIR_INVALID, MCP_SERVER_NOT_INSTALLED, MCP_SERVER_FAILED, MCP_TIMEOUT. Tool codes are passed through (e.g. RUN_NOT_FOUND, DECISION_HASH_MISMATCH).
